summary: ata_hosttest.c's two write-count rows, which the diskrate suite runs, with faults in ata.c

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/rach2" "$t/tests/host"
cp -R rach2/sys "$t/rach2/sys"
cp tests/host/ata_hosttest.c "$t/tests/host/"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
cd "$t"
deps=$(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/ata_hosttest.c | sed 's/host-deps://' | tr '\n' ' ')
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I ${TREE}/utils -I ${TREE}/krffs -I ${TREE}/tests/host/compat -o ${WORK}/ata_hosttest tests/host/ata_hosttest.c $deps

faults.name: pio
faults.summary: every write sent through the data port, the DMA path off

lines: ata-test: fail: a DMA write uses one data command per 32 KiB and no data-port sectors

faults.name: spin
faults.summary: a wait that reads the status 512 times before it sleeps

lines: ata-test: fail: a delayed write and flush use at most 32 status reads per 32 KiB
